Audit reference-derived fixture generators and implementations for copied or adapted upstream source and confirm the actual reference version for each fixture.
Verify the Plotly bundle bytes and identify embedded dependency notices; reconcile differing copyright headers without discarding either.

Identify all actually linked Rust and native components, especially LLVM bundle third-party code, zstd/zlib/lzma where present, and CUDA/runtime libraries; collect version-specific copyright, license and NOTICE texts, assess modifications, and reconcile them against SBOM expressions and each artifact.

Establish complete artifact-specific dependency notice coverage and verify all applicable license and NOTICE texts are included in the final artifacts before release; the existing LLVM, Burn and CubeCL notices and SBOM alone do not establish completeness.
